xna-type.name: ContentProcessorAttribute
xna-type.summary: Gets any existing content processor components.
xna-type.remarks: If you are developing a custom processor, it must use this attribute. The processor must also extend the ContentProcessor class.

property.name: DisplayName
property.summary: Gets or sets the string representing the processor in a user interface. This name is not used by the content pipeline and should not be passed to the BuildAssets task. It is used for display purposes only.
property.syntax: public virtual string DisplayName { get; set; }
property.value: Name displayed in the user interface.
